root_cause.text: The functions `nft_map_catchall_deactivate` and `nft_map_catchall_activate` in `net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c` prematurely break out of their loops after processing only the first catchall element, leaving subsequent pending catchall elements unhandled during set/map teardown, causing a reference counting mismatch that leads to a warning in `nft_data_release` during abort.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes two `break;` statements (one in each function) to ensure all catchall elements are iterated. The commit message states: "If the map holding the catchall elements is also going away, its required to toggle all catchall elements and not just the first viable candidate." The reported warning trace shows `nft_data_release` being called from `__nft_set_elem_destroy` during `nf_tables_abort_release`, confirming incomplete element handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature break in nft_map_catchall_deactivate to properly deactivate all catchall elements instead of only the first one.
intent_record.what: Removed a break statement inside a loop in the nft_map_catchall_deactivate function, after nft_setelem_data_deactivate.
intent_record.how: The loop will now continue processing all catchall elements instead of exiting after the first one, ensuring all matching elements are deactivated.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature break in nft_map_catchall_activate to ensure all catchall elements are processed instead of only the first.
intent_record.what: Removed a 'break;' statement inside a loop in the nft_map_catchall_activate function.
intent_record.how: Previously the loop would exit after processing the first catchall element; now it continues to process all remaining catchall elements, applying clear and activate operations to each.

    netfilter: nf_tables: drop map element references from preparation phase

bic_trace_step.reason: The diff introduces nft_map_catchall_deactivate and nft_map_catchall_activate functions. Both contain a loop with `list_for_each_entry` followed by a `break` after processing only the first active catchall element, e.g., in nft_map_catchall_deactivate: 'list_for_each_entry(catchall, &set->catchall_list, list) { ... nft_setelem_data_deactivate(...); break; }'. This leaves remaining catchall elements unhandled, matching the root cause of premature loop termination. No fix (such as removing the break) is present in this commit.
